title: Power series for the inverse sine
statement: For every real number $z$ with $|z|<1$, the series $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty}\binom{2j}{j}z^{2j}/2^{2j}$ sums to $(1-z^2)^{-1/2}$. For every $z\in[-1,1]$, the series $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty}\frac{\binom{2j}{j}}{2^{2j}(2j+1)}z^{2j+1}$ and the series with coefficient $0$ at even powers and coefficient $\frac{2\binom{k-1}{(k-1)/2}}{k2^k}$ at odd powers $z^k$ both sum to $\arcsin z$. At $z=1$, both series sum to $\pi/2$, and at $z=-1$, both sum to $-\pi/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $z\in\mathbb R$ with $|z|<1$ for the binomial series identity
